events.title: Paul Birch leaves 애스턴 빌라 after 10 years to join 울버햄프턴 원더러스 for £400,000.

아스널 suffer their first league defeat of the season in their 24th game, going down 2–1 to 첼시 at Stamford Bridge . They remain top of the league by a single point, although 리버풀 have two games in hand. 셰필드 유나이티드 are now just two points adrift of safety after a 4–1 home win over 사우샘프턴. In the Second Division, Oldham suffer a shock 5–1 defeat at Oxford.
애스턴 빌라 sign defender Neil Cox from 스컨소프 유나이티드 for £400,000, a record fee for a Fourth Division player.
리버풀 and 에버턴 draw 0–0 in an all Merseyside FA Cup fifth round tie at Anfield .
셰필드 웬즈데이 sign 19-year-old striker Gordon Watson from 찰턴 애슬레틱 for £250,000. The FA Cup fourth round replay between 리버풀 ends in a dramatic 4–4 draw at Goodison Park , forcing a second replay.
In a record fee for a non-league player, 바닛 striker Andy Clarke joins 윔블던 for £250,000.
케니 달글리시 announces his resignation as 리버풀 manager. Long-serving coach Ronnie Moran is appointed caretaker manager.

아스널 return to the top of the First Division on goal difference, beating 크리스털 팰리스 4–0 at Highbury, while 리버풀 suffer a shock 3–1 defeat at Luton. 윔블던 go sixth with a 5–1 win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 at Plough Lane. In the first leg of the League Cup semi finals, 셰필드 웬즈데이 win 2–0 at 첼시 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 win 1–0 at Leeds.

에버턴 beat 리버풀 1–0 in the second replay of the FA Cup fifth round tie at Goodison Park, ending 리버풀's hopes of a unique second double. 셰필드 웬즈데이 reach their first cup final in 25 years by beating 첼시 3–1 in the League Cup semi-final second leg.

February draws to a close with 아스널 now ahead of 리버풀 at the top of the First Division on goal difference, while 크리스털 팰리스 are five points behind. At the other end of the table, a splendid run of form has moved 셰필드 유나이티드 six points clear of bottom-placed 더비 카운티. The Blades are level on goal difference with 코번트리 시티, 선덜랜드 and 퀸스 파크 레인저스. 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 올덤 애슬레틱 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 continue to lead the way in the Second Division. 미들즈브러, 노츠 카운티, Brighton and 밀월 occupy the playoff zone, with 브리스틀 시티 continuing to turn up the heat on them in their bid for a second successive promotion.
